def is_square_attacked(board, square, attacker_color):

    x, y = to_coord(square)
    
    # Check pawn attacks
    pawn_direction = -1 if attacker_color == 'w' else 1
    if get_piece(board, x - 1, y - pawn_direction) == attacker_color + 'P' or \

def apply_move(board, move):

    new_board = board.copy()

    if len(move) > 4:
